response:
It is completely understandable that you are feeling disheartened. When it seems like everyone around you is hitting romantic milestones, it is easy to feel left behind and wonder if something is wrong. Please know that there is absolutely nothing wrong with you. Society puts an immense amount of pressure on us to follow a specific timeline, but everyone’s life unfolds at its own pace. Being in your mid-20s and never having had a boyfriend does not mean you are unlovable or that you will never find a partner. 

Many people experience their first serious relationship later in life, even if it doesn't look that way on social media. Try to be gentle with yourself and avoid comparing your journey to others. Your worth is not defined by your relationship status. Focus on nurturing your own interests, friendships, and personal growth. You are building a full, rich life, which is a beautiful foundation for whenever a relationship does come along.
